master.subCopy:
Citi will be progressively converting our credit cards to the Mastercard network.

As part of this change, we wish to inform you that your Citi ULTIMA Main and Supplementary Visa card(s) (if any) will be discontinued soon. To ensure you can continue enjoying your Citi ULTIMA benefits and experience a seamless conversion of your Citi ULTIMA Visa Card, please activate the Citi Mastercard.

The new Citi ULTIMA Mastercard has been mailed to you, together with the activation details. Once activated, you will continue to enjoy all the Citi ULTIMA privileges on the ULTIMA Mastercard. You will also have access to exclusive ULTIMA Mastercard priceless experiences.

Please refer to the notification email where the formal discontinuation date has been shared.

termsList.title: Is the conversion of my Visa card to Mastercard mandatory?
termsList.copy:
No. It is not mandatory.

We have sent you a corresponding Mastercard, so you can continue to enjoy the same benefits offered by your Visa Card. If you choose to activate your Mastercard, any outstanding balance (credit or debit), available Citi Miles/Citi ThankYouSM Points/cash back, Citi PayAll and Citi instalment loan(s) and/or balance transfer(s) - where applicable - will be transferred from your Visa card to Mastercard.

termsandconditionsJourneys.condition1Copy:
See the offer here.
  • Open tickets refers to travel ticket with no fixed travel dates or times, but a fixed validity period.
  • Open-jaw refers to flights to one city with return from another eligible city (e.g. A to B, C to A. If B and C are neighboring airports in the same city, this will not be seen as open-jaw tickets.
  • Open returns refer to flexible tickets as you do not need to specify the exact time and date you want to return on.
  • Layover is short stop or break on one single journey/itinerary/trip while onto your final destination. Any stop(s) between your origin city and your final destination city and is less than 24 hours for international itinerary or less than four hours for domestic itinerary is a layover.
  • Stop-over refers to long stop and is more than 24 hours. An example is going from Singapore to Osaka and staying for multiple days in Tokyo, the connecting city, either en-route to or from Osaka.
  • Circle trips refers to air-travel in which the point of origin is also the ultimate destination but it involves more than one stopovers. For example: A to B, B to C, C to D and D to A.
  • A connection refers to changing plans in an airport, most frequently an airline hub. Any layover of less than 24 hours is considered a connection.
  • Non-restricted fares refer to full-fare tickets and such tickets are not cheapest fare and usually fully refundable with complete flexibility.
  • A codeshare flight refers to a flight marketed and ticketed by one airline (Marketing Carrier) but operated another airline (Operating Carrier), typically because the marketing airline does not directly service a certain flight route. For example, a flight marketed and ticketed by Japan Airlines but operated by American Airline is a codeshare flight.

I General Conditions
  1. Flight bookings can be made up to 9 months in advance for the outbound travel date. For example, booking made on 1 January 2024 for outbound travel on 30 September 2024.
  2. Offer is valid for Citi ULTIMA main Cardholders only.
  3. To qualify for the complimentary companion ticket:
    The paid ticket must be purchased on non-restricted fare on a participating airline and charged to a valid Citi ULTIMA Card
    All travel must start and end in city where the card is issued
    All travel must be ticketed in the country where card is issued
    The Cardholder who purchases the companion ticket(s) must be one of the travellers
    The companion using the complimentary ticket must travel with and have the same itinerary as the cardholder with the paid ticket purchased ticket and companion ticket must be issued at the same time
    The complimentary companion ticket is based on lowest available fare booking class
    Only one companion ticket can be redeemed in the same itinerary
    Only one stop-over is allowed in the itinerary.
    One stop-over and open jaw are not allowed concurrently.
  4. 4. Open tickets, open returns, circle trips, and round the world trips are not permitted.
  5. Complimentary companion ticket and discount are only applicable to airfares and does not include taxes, surcharges or any other fees.
  6. Discounted airfares are applicable for all booking class for business and first class, subject to availability.

II. Reservations
  1. 1. Minimum 72 hour advance reservation is required. Reservations, ticketing and departures less than 72 hours are not permitted.
  2. Bookings must be done through a Citi ULTIMA Lifestyle Relationship Manager.

III. Charges and Cancellation
  1. At the time of booking, all applicable taxes, surcharges and fees for paid and complimentary companion tickets will be charged to the Cardholder's Citi ULTIMA Card.
  2. Ticket issuance fee per ticket is US$80 and is non-refundable. Ticket issuance fee for paid ticket and complimentary companion ticket will be borne by cardholder.
  3. Itinerary change and refund are subjected to the terms and conditions of the refund, cancellation & itinerary change policies of the airlines.
  4. Once paid and complimentary companion tickets are issued, any deviations or changes in routing by cardholder will be at the cardholders expense. This includes:
    Re-issuance fee of US$80 per ticket, amendment and cancellation fee, taxes and surcharges and ticket price difference of both paid and companion tickets).

IV. Miscellaneous
  1. Companion tickets are non-transferable and non-endorsable.
  2. Tickets are not interchangeable for travel on other airlines. Any travel on non-participating airlines must be ticketed and paid for separately. Codeshare flights do not apply unless otherwise stated. Codes share flights are allowed only on Lufthansa and Japan Airlines for one leg per outbound and inbound flight when alternative routes are not available.
  3. Privileges cannot be combined or applied with other promotions, discounts, offers or internet fares.
  4. Published rates for participating airlines is applicable for guests if they want to book via Citi ULTIMA Lifestyle Relationship Manager and charged to a valid Citi ULTIMA Card.

LUXURY AIRPORT TRANSFER SERVICE
See the offer here.
I General Conditions
  1. Valid for Citi ULTIMA main cardmembers only.
  2. Each Citi ULTIMA Cardmember is entitled to complimentary one-way airport limousine services per flight itinerary.
  3. An itinerary is defined as either a one way or return to and from the destination country from the Cardmember’s country of issuance. This is inclusive of itineraries with more than 1 stopover eg. Singapore Cardmember travelling to Thailand, from Thailand to Taiwan and Taiwan back to Singapore will be able to enjoy the limo service in Thailand.
  4. Eligible cardmembers must purchase business class and above airfares entirely on the ULTIMA card and be travelling with full-fledged carriers. This service is not available for itineraries with travel on budget carriers. Cardmembers who travel on budget carriers will not be eligible to this benefit. For the full list of budget carriers, please refer to this link: www2023.icao.int/sustainability/Documents/LCC-List.pdf
  5. Luxury airport transfer services have a complimentary transfer allowance, which is based on driven kilometers in each city. Any excess charges beyond the complimentary transfer allowance will be advised to Cardmember upon confirmation of the booking. Cardmember will be charged for excess charge per kilometer.
  6. Additional charges for extra-stops, cancellation/amendment fees and waiting time charges will apply and are to be borne by Cardmember. All charges must be made on Citibank ULTIMA card.
  7. Luxury airport transfer imposes limits on the number of passengers per car and/or the number of luggage per passenger. This service is limited to a maximum of 2 large suitcases and 2 passengers per car.

II Reservations
  1. Bookings must be made through a Citi ULTIMA Lifestyle Relationship Manager or where available, the Citi ULTIMA Concierge.
  2. All bookings is subject to availability.
  3. Please provide number of passenger and luggage during booking.
  4. Booking for the services must be made at least 72 hours prior to commencement of travel. The bank reserves the right to reject booking of services if less than 72 hours before commencement of travel.

III Cancellation and Charges
  1. There is no charge for any cancellations made more than 48 hours in advance of the service and capped entitlement will not be considered utilized.
  2. For any cancellations made within 48 hours prior to the scheduled service, there is a 100% charge equivalent to full invoice.
  3. There is no charge for any amendments to the services made more than 48 hours in advance of the service. For any amendment made less than 48 hours in advance of the service, this will be considered as a cancellation and a new booking. Hence, one redemption will be considered utilized. Cardholder will need to pay the additional fees that is required for the new booking.
  4. New bookings will be subjected to the standard Terms and Conditions, additional fees that is required will be applicable.
  5. The bank and participating partner will review each case to determine for any exceptional circumstances.
  6. Additional charges will apply for additional luggage, a larger vehicle or child or infant car seat if required. Please provide number of passenger, luggage and number of infant seats required during booking. Please note that provision of infant seats are mandatory in some destinations.
  7. The following fees and charges will be levied by the limousine service provider onto the Primary Cardmember's Citi ULTIMA card, should these scenarios occur:
    1. Cancellation: Any cancellation or amendment must be done at least 24 hours in advance of the arranged Airport Transfer. Any cancellation or amendment submitted within the 24 hours prior to the arranged airport Transfer will be treated as a deduction of one Qualifying Entitlement. Please contact Concierge via the Citi ULTIMA concierge (6334-7598) for cancellations or amendment.
    2. Amendment: An amendment fee of USD10.00 and/or any change fee imposed will be charged per each amendment made 24 hours or less if the service provider is able to fulfil assignment on the new date. There is no charge for amendments made 24 hours prior to the pickup time.
    3. No Show: A 'no show' is defined as the Cardmember failing to show up for an arranged Airport Transfer. A cancellation fee of 100% based on estimated charges will be imposed for no show. The grace waiting time for any Airport Transfer shall be limited to the following in (i) & (ii) beyond which, it will be treated as a 'no show':
      • (i) Airport Arrival pickups: 60-minute grace waiting time from actual flight landing time
      • (ii) All other pickups/Airport Departure: 15-minute grace waiting time
    4. No-Show by Driver: If there is a no-show by driver, customer has to call Concierge and Concierge shall arrange with the service provider for an immediate rescue alternative from 1-hour control call. If a rescue limousine is unavailable at point of No-Show, there will be no charge imposed on client.
  8. The service provider will release the driver upon the end of the waiting period if passenger is not on board by the 60th minute for Airport Arrival pickups and 15th minute for All other pickups/Airport Departure.

IV Miscellaneous

In some countries, services may come with a non-excludable guarantee or warranty that they will be provided with due care and skill. The nature and application of these guarantees or warranties will depend on the relevant country.

  • Certain room categories may not be eligible for upgrade.
  • Upgrades have no monetary value.
  • The Hotel reserves the right to charge additional fees for room upgrades higher than one category above reserved room type.

  • Cancellation and no show fees will be charged to the Citi ULTIMA Card account.
  • Once reservations are confirmed, all associated cost (amendment fee, cancellation fee, taxes and surcharges and room price difference) will be borne by Cardholder.
  • Any change or modification will be considered a new booking and subject to current rates and availability.
  • Cancellation and amendments must be made at least 7 calendar days before date of arrival by calling a Citi ULTIMA Lifestyle Relationship Manager, or where available, the Citi ULTIMA Concierge. Where the Participating Hotels has a different cancellation or amendment policy requiring more than 7 calendar days notification, the request is subject to the policy of the Participating Hotel.

gastro.copy: Citi ULTIMA proudly presents an exclusive, year-round partnership with MICHELIN Singapore. Gastronomic Dining Collection is the upper echelon of bespoke dining. Enjoy exclusive chef-curated dinners, featuring collaborations between local and international chefs from MICHELIN Starred restaurants, and a chance to meet the chefs behind the creations.
gastro.copy2: Embark on epicurean journeys at these exceptional hotels or set sail on a luxury private yacht charter. These privileges are available all year round.
gastro.chefCopy:
Discover an evocative expression of Southeast Asia's rich gastronomic traditions. Under the theme of Heritage Larder, Seroja and Linamnam draw upon native ingredients, ancestral techniques and personal histories to present a contemporary interpretation of the Malay Archipelago and the Philippines.

At the helm are two of Southeast Asia’s most distinguished young chefs: Chef Kevin Wong of newly award Two-MICHELIN-Starred Seroja and Chef Don Baldosano of One-MICHELIN-Starred Linamnam. Both recipients of the MICHELIN Guide Young Chef Award, each has earned acclaim for bringing the cuisine of his homeland into a new fine-dining vernacular while remaining deeply connected to its origins.

Together, they illuminate the ingredients, techniques and traditions of the region with a shared conviction that its indigenous larder belongs at the forefront of contemporary gastronomy.



The Chefs
gastro.chef1Copy:
An alumnus of prestigious establishments in France, the U.S. and Singapore, owner‑chef Kevin Wong opened Seroja in 2022 as a tribute to his love of the Malay Archipelago.
His menus celebrate Malaysia’s culinary traditions through an abundance of local produce, spices and time-honoured techniques. Meticulous, artful plating is matched by flavours that are subtle and finely balanced, complemented by thoughtfully considered wine and non-alcoholic beverage pairings.
gastro.chef2Copy:
Working solo from his garden kitchen, Chef Don Baldosano serves just 10 diners in what was once his childhood bedroom and is now an elegant dining space adorned with woven wall coverings, wooden floors and Tiffany-style lamps.
His deeply personal dishes are rooted in regional Filipino traditions and shaped by his distinctive culinary philosophy. Expect creations such as lamb dumplings in chicharon broth and turon with aged banana and jackfruit. Dining at this intimate hidden gem is a truly memorable experience.
